Economy · India

Indian Banks and Companies Report Mixed First Quarter Financial Results

Several Indian banks and companies have released their first-quarter financial results for the fiscal year 2026. While some, like ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and Yes Bank, reported significant profit increases driven by factors such as loan growth and interest income, others, like Wipro, saw profits remain relatively flat. Companies like BHEL and JSW Steel reported profit growth, with BHEL swinging to a net profit and JSW Steel's profit doubling.
